earthquakes.description: Earthquake catalog search (ComCat, FDSN event service): one row per event.

starttime.desc: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time (UTC); default 30 days ago

alertlevel.desc: PAGER level: green, yellow, orange, red

eventtype.desc: earthquake (default all: also quarry blast, explosion ...)

minfelt.desc: minimum Did You Feel It? reports

earthquake_count.description: Number of events matching the same filters (one row: count, maxAllowed).

starttime.desc: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time (UTC); default 30 days ago

alertlevel.desc: PAGER level: green, yellow, orange, red

eventtype.desc: earthquake (default all: also quarry blast, explosion ...)

minfelt.desc: minimum Did You Feel It? reports

water.description: USGS Water Data OGC API (v1): daily values, continuous (15-minute) values, latest values, monitoring locations, field measurements, annual peaks.

collection.desc: daily, continuous, latest-continuous, latest-daily, monitoring-locations, field-measurements, peaks, time-series-metadata, parameter-codes ...

monitoring_location_id.desc: USGS-01646500 (bare site numbers get the USGS- prefix); comma-separated

parameter_code.desc: 00060 discharge, 00065 gage height, 00010 water temperature, 72019 depth to water ...

time.desc: ISO 8601 interval: 2024-01-01/2024-12-31, 2024-01-01/.., or a duration such as P7D

state_code.desc: state FIPS (VT or Vermont are converted)

site_type_code.desc: ST stream, GW well, LK lake, SP spring, AT atmosphere ...

skipGeometry.desc: true drops coordinates (default true except for monitoring-locations)

daily.name: daily
daily.description: daily values (one per day: mean/max/min by statistic_id), since a site's start

continuous.name: continuous
continuous.description: continuous sensor values, usually every 15 minutes (recent years; large)

latest-continuous.name: latest-continuous
latest-continuous.description: the latest continuous value of every time series (use state_code for a whole state)

latest-daily.name: latest-daily
latest-daily.description: the latest daily value of every time series

monitoring-locations.name: monitoring-locations
monitoring-locations.description: site metadata: name, type, state, county, HUC, drainage area, coordinates

latest-field-measurements.name: latest-field-measurements
latest-field-measurements.description: the latest field measurement of every series (gage height, discharge, groundwater level)

channel-measurements.name: channel-measurements
channel-measurements.description: channel geometry and velocity taken with streamflow field measurements (width, area, velocity)

peaks.name: peaks
peaks.description: annual peak streamflow and gage height

time-series-metadata.name: time-series-metadata
time-series-metadata.description: which parameters and statistics a site has, with begin/end dates

streamflow_daily.name: Daily mean streamflow
streamflow_daily.description: daily with parameter_code 00060, statistic_id 00003 (cubic feet per second)

groundwater_levels.name: Groundwater levels
groundwater_levels.description: field-measurements with parameter_code 72019 (depth to water, feet below land surface)
